Q5731.reason: The brother’s estate is measured by the uncle’s life and can divest the uncle’s vested life estate on the uncle’s move, so it is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie rather than a present estate or a remainder.

Q5115.reason: Activating glycolysis at exercise onset raises pyruvate formation faster than mitochondria clear it, so LDH converts more pyruvate to lactate; oxygen availability, failure to form pyruvate, and a falling pH do not increase lactate production.

Q5932.reason: Intermittent high-intensity work drives catecholamine-stimulated hepatic glucose output above muscle uptake, so blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes rather than staying flat or falling.
